notes.title: Update 1.6 Achievements!
notes.content:
Unleash Your Inner Mummy Slayer – Achievements Now Live!

Get ready for another thrilling update for The Pyramid Of Bones! We’re excited to introduce the brand-new Achievements system, bringing even more excitement and challenges to your fight against ancient evil.

Show off your accomplishments and let everyone know you're the ultimate mummy hunter!

Jump back into the chaos, claim your achievements, and prove yourself in the most intense battles yet. Happy hunting, and may your achievement collection grow as legendary as your courage!


[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/svySWd3/Mummy-Death1000.png[/img][/url]

1.6 Contents:

* Achievements!
* Rebalancing pass
* New SFX

notes.title: Update 1.5 Controller Update!
notes.content:
Welcome to the latest update for The Pyramid Of Bones the thrilling game about killing mummies and saving the world from ancient evil! We're excited to announce that we've just released a brand new controller update that will enhance your gaming experience like never before.

With this update, we've introduced a range of new controller options that will allow you to customize your controls to suit your playstyle. Whether you prefer a classic joystick or a more modern touchpad, we've got you covered. We've also added support for a variety of popular controllers, including Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo Switch controllers.

So what are you waiting for? Grab your favorite controller and jump back into "Mummy Massacre" today to experience all the exciting new features of our latest update. Happy hunting!

notes.title: Update 1.4!
notes.content:
People are getting thrown out of the map by tombstones...???

Introducing "So it's been a month" Update!

* Fixed a variety of wall glitches.
* Fixed a tombstone bug.
* The game should pickup speed a bit faster
* Controller support is complete. Tutorial for it is still WIP

Thanks for playing everyone!

notes.title: Update 1.3!
notes.content:
People kept getting stuck in corners so we decided to let have a better chance of escaping by allowing rolling through mummy hordes. This feature might get removed for multiplayer as a bit chunk of the fun is  saving your friends when they get stuck

Introducing "Roll Baby Roll Update"!

* Players can now roll through enemies if traveling fast enough (very useful for when getting cornered!)
* Fixed a very rare leaderboards freeze.
* Added limited gamepad support (a small taste before next weeks update).

Thanks for playing everyone!

notes.title: Update 1.2!
notes.content:
After watching some streams I decided we needed some balancing. Especially for the stronger characters and especially when playing Single Player.

Introducing "The Balancing Update"!

* Made the game [i]Slightly[/i] easier in single player to avoid getting stomped.
* Added a "Cayote Timer" to the players health, giving you that tiny edge over the eternal darkness.
* Behavior adjustments to the Jumper Mummy.
* Optimization pass, does wonders when hordes form.

Next up we will be adding controller support :)

Thanks for playing everyone!

notes.title: Update 1.1!
notes.content:
I decided to sit down and hammer some day one bandages on the old codebase (well....day 2 bandages)

* Sprint is now default! (Shift is now for walking) 
* You can now see your own score in leaderboards even if you didn't make the top 7
* Made sure that everyone has a username (sorry for those that missed out on the leaderboards!)
* You can now roll with the right click mouse button! (remind me to make you some real key bindings)
* Worked on our flagship game that you should totally Wishlist! (but you don't see me bragging about it!

Thanks for playing everyone!
